candidates.name: David - The Movie Trailer
candidates.description: Perfect for Movie Trailers, Movie Spoofs, and anything that requires that movie voice sound. David has voiced thousands of actual movie trailers.

candidates.name: K. V. Hagen - Exceptionally Deep Bass
candidates.description: A rare, exceptionally deep male voice with a naturally low, effortless bass register. Warm, resonant and commanding, with a calm, measured, hypnotic delivery and natural, unforced depth, clarity and gravitas. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, documentaries, cinematic storytelling, trailers, meditation, sleep stories, commercials, true crime, history, mythology, poetry, fantasy, sci-fi, gothic fiction & horror.
